======
RULES
======

[ Boom3 ] -> [ Fresh ] again
[ Boom2 ] -> [ Boom3 ] again
[ Boom1 ] -> [ Boom2 ] again
[ Fresh ] -> [ Boom1 ]
[ > Player | Bomb ] -> [ Player | Boom1 ] again
